Trente mille ? Ta femme-là donne le même froid gratuitement dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The grandmother, arms wrapped around herself, shivers and asks. The son shows the remote proudly and answers. The grandmother jerks her chin toward the daughter-in-law and answers, her face clearly visible.
chute: The daughter-in-law keeps her arms crossed, her face icy and offended, while the son freezes. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the daughter-in-law's icy offended face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA BELLE-FILLE QUAND MAMIE VA DORMIR :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : la clim payante contre le froid gratuit de la belle-fille, le fils paie deux fois

titre: La cuisine au feu de bois
lieu: backyard of a family house in Koumassi, Abidjan, a cooking pot on three stones over a wood fire with light smoke, a small unused gas bottle next to it, a low stool, midday

persos.desc: young woman around 19, rose-and-violet t-shirt, short natural hair, holding ONE single smartphone
persos.pose: standing on the left, pointing at the smoke

persos.desc: grandmother in her 70s, chocolate-and-sunflower wrap dress, a headscarf, holding ONE single wooden spoon
persos.pose: sitting on the low stool in the foreground on the right, next to the pot

dialogue: Mamie, prends le gaz ! La fumée-là te fatigue dêh !
Ma fille, sans fumée, ton grand-père va voir qui mange sa viande.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The granddaughter points at the smoke, coughing lightly, and insists. The grandmother keeps the spoon above the pot, glances left and right, and answers in a sly low voice, her face clearly visible.
chute: The grandmother gives a sly wink while the granddaughter's mouth drops open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the grandmother's sly smiling face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: PAPI EN COMPTANT LES MORCEAUX CE SOIR :
mecanisme: révélation inattendue : la tradition du feu de bois sert de couverture au vol de viande de Mamie
